scoring_justification: The main claim is a compression-induced peak near 4.5 eV; the ratio of ε₂ at the peak for -8% relative to 0% is recomputed directly from the agent's dielectric_function.csv. Band gap trend is structural, but the load‑bearing dielectric peak is recomputed.

columns.band_gap_eV: float, DFT-PBE indirect band gap in eV

outputs.description: DFT-PBE band gap of single-layer GeS at biaxial strains -8%, 0%, +8%.

columns.epsilon1: float, real part of dielectric function (dimensionless)
columns.epsilon2: float, imaginary part of dielectric function (dimensionless)

outputs.description: In-plane averaged real and imaginary parts of the dielectric function for strains -8%, 0%, +8% over 0-8 eV.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute the peak ratio of epsilon2 near 4.5 eV for strain -8% relative to 0% and verify the strain-induced band gap trend.

steps.description: Verify strain-induced band gap trend: gap(-8%) < gap(0%) - 0.2 eV and |gap(+8%) - gap(0%)| ≤ 0.1 eV.
Recompute the ratio of ε₂ at peak near 4.5 eV for strain -8% relative to 0%; require ratio > 1.3.
